about: Cinder Warden tree rework (v81t, staging trial). Points go into trees, not single skills. Every 5 points in a tree unlocks its next skill (8 per tree, the 8th at 40 is the ultimate). Each point between unlocks adds that tree's bonus to every skill in it. Points 41-50 add damage only. Shared point math lives in skilltrees-common.json; trees, bonuses and new skills live here; js/ab-skilltree.js reads it. Skill names and about text are Koto's (see KOTO-NAMES.md). Delete this file (or set enabled false) and the Warden uses the old per-skill system again. v84n: linear trees, 9 nodes (A1 1, P 5, A 10, P 15, A 20, P 25, A 30, P 35, ULT 40), no pick pairs; each tree has a mark (sig) applied by its A1 (signature node). See tools/build_v84n_trees.py.

trees.name: Brand
trees.about: Heavy steel and fire strikes: cleaves, a dash, a hook, and burning combos.
trees.sigAbout: Ash Strike becomes Searing Brand: the cut presses a Brand into the foe. Branded foes take more damage from you; every Brand skill feeds or spends it.

trees.name: Ember
trees.about: Kiln fire, wards and explosions: coals at range, a ward, and room-clearing blasts.
trees.sigAbout: Cinder Spark sets foes Kindled at range; Ember's blasts spread it and Clinker Fall cashes it in.

trees.name: Warden
trees.about: Armor, retaliation and a last stand: turn defense into counter-damage.
trees.sigAbout: Iron Call is the Warden's stand: foes around you are Challenged (slowed, and every hit on them mends you a little); Anvil Bash spends it.

upgrades.about: Tree-mode upgrades to existing Warden skills (only while the tree system is on).

kiln_hook.about: Also pulls what it hits toward you.

ash_skin.about: Also raises all resists a little per rank.

skills.name: Quenchcrack
skills.about: Your blows make armor brittle, and every fourth swing finds the flaw.
notes: Cracked armor makes the target easier to hit for a few seconds.

skills.name: Bellows Rush
skills.about: You land three quick cuts, then a burst of fire.
notes: Each cut is a melee hit, so Quenchcrack counts all three.
This spends every Brand on the foe, dealing +12% damage per Brand.

skills.name: Kilnborn
skills.about: For a while you are the furnace. Every swing goes all the way around and throws fire.
notes: Splash fire hits foes near the one you struck.

skills.name: Clinker Fall
skills.about: You hurl hot clinker that bursts, and the ground stays burning.
notes: The first burst spends every Kindled stack, dealing +10% damage per stack.

skills.name: Last Ember
skills.about: When Ash Ward ends, it explodes. Foes you recently burned also explode when they die.
notes: Death bursts are capped so a pack cannot chain forever.
Kindled foes also burst into fire when they die.

skills.name: Drowned Furnace
skills.about: Fire crits deal 1.75 times damage and ignore 25% of fire resist. Every 3rd cast is a free bloom, 1.5 times as wide.

skills.name: Spiteplate
skills.about: Whoever hits your armor gets hit back by it.
notes: Warden tree damage bonuses raise this too.
Challenged foes take +1% more damage from you per stack, and can carry 4 stacks.

skills.name: Blood for Iron
skills.about: You pay in blood and your armor comes back thicker.
notes: A safe way to drop under 40% life for The Wall That Burns.

skills.name: The Wall That Burns
skills.about: You deal 1 damage per 10 armor. When your life is below 40%, Spiteplate hits twice as hard and you swing twice as fast.
notes: Armor turns into damage at 1 damage per 10 armor converted.

skills.name: Deep Brand
skills.about: Your Brands hit harder and last longer.
notes: Branded foes take +1% more damage from you per Brand, and Brands last 2 seconds longer.

skills.name: Brandfall
skills.about: A Branded foe that dies bursts into fire around it.
notes: The burst deals 18% of the foe's max life as fire, and hits harder with more Brands.

skills.name: Iron Call
skills.about: You strike steel on steel. Fire bursts around you, and nearby foes are Challenged: they are slowed, they take +4% damage from you per stack (up to 3), and hits on them heal you.
notes: Each Challenged stack heals you for 1.5% of the damage you deal to that foe.

skills.name: Anvil Bash
skills.about: A heavy shield blow that spends every Challenged stack on the foe, dealing +15% damage per stack.

spellBookHook.about: Next phase. ABTree.replaceTree(player, slotIndex, treeId) swaps one of the 3 tree slots for another tree def (registered with ABTree.registerTree) and resets every tree point for free. Not reachable from the game yet.
